text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Blocker＞ ＜Armor Purge＞ [End of Attack] [End of Opponent's Turn] [Once per Turn] You may play 1 play cost 5 or lower card with the [Machine], [Cyborg] or [TS] trait from this Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.

text_sections.label: Special Play Condition
text_sections.text: Assembly -2: [Blimpmon]/Tamer card w/[TS] trait When this would be played, by placing the specified cards from the trash under it, reduce the play cost.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [Your Turn] This Digimon's attack target can't change.
